_comment: Filler for the newsletter's newspaper layout. Every business here is invented, and the reviews are part of the joke -- keep it that way. Nothing in this file should name a real company or a real person. Entries are drawn deck-style (no repeat until the pool is exhausted), so pool size sets how long before a repeat: at 2 ads and 5 classifieds a send, this is roughly 4-5 weeks. Top up with `python creator/generate_classifieds.py`.

classifieds: FOR SALE: Chair. Sat in once. Four dollars.
LOST: Enthusiasm. Last seen Monday morning. No reward offered.
WANTED: Someone to take the last cup so I am not the one who has to make more.
FREE: Half a birthday cake, kitchen counter. Was free at 9am. Still free. This is now concerning.
FOUND: One (1) spoon. Owner may claim it by describing it in detail.
NOTICE: Whoever labelled their lunch 'DO NOT EAT' has been heard.
FOR SALE: Desk plant, mostly conceptual at this point. Best offer.
SEEKING: The person who knows how the good kettle works. Please come forward.
REWARD: For information leading to the return of the large scissors.
PUBLIC APOLOGY: To everyone in the 2pm meeting. You know what I did.
FOR SALE: Novelty tie. Worn ironically. Now simply a tie.
WANTED: Second opinion on whether that noise is normal.
LOST: One umbrella, black, indistinguishable from every other umbrella.
NOTICE: The microwave and I have reached an understanding. Do not interfere.
FREE TO GOOD HOME: Three-ring binder. Two rings functional.
FOR SALE: Ergonomic mouse. Did not work. I remain unergonomic.
LOST: The good pen. You know the one. I know you know.
WANTED: Anyone who remembers what the recurring Thursday meeting is for.
NOTICE: The plant on the windowsill is not doing well and we all know it.
FOUND: A phone charger. It fits nothing any of us own.
FOR SALE: Standing desk. Barely stood at.
SEEKING: Closure regarding the missing office chair. Any information welcome.
FREE: Twelve identical conference tote bags. Take as many as you can carry.
NOTICE: To whoever keeps setting the thermostat to 19. We will find you.
WANTED: Someone to sit near the door and handle it.
LOST: My train of thought, somewhere around 11:15. Reward negotiable.
FOR SALE: Second monitor. Displays things. Adequate.
FOUND: A single earring in the stairwell. Held at reception. Untouched since March.
NOTICE: The photocopier is fine. It is you who must change.
SEEKING: The recipe for whatever was in the kitchen last Tuesday.
FREE: A box of pens that all write in the same disappointing blue.
WANTED: Volunteer to be the one who says the meeting could have been an email.
LOST: One (1) sense of urgency. Last seen shortly before the deadline moved.
FOR SALE: Desk fan. Two speeds, both wrong.
NOTICE: There is a birthday card going around. Sign it. Do not read the others first.
FOUND: An unlabelled USB stick. Nobody is brave enough.
SEEKING: Anyone who can explain what the fourth key on my keyring opens.
FREE: Motivational poster. No longer working on me. May work on you.
WANTED: The person who parks perfectly straight every day. Teach us.
LOST: The lid to the good travel mug. Grief counselling available.
FOR SALE: Whiteboard markers, assorted, all dry.
NOTICE: The lift makes that sound for everyone, not just you.
FOUND: Somebody's reading glasses. They have been on my head for three days.
SEEKING: A reason to keep the fax machine. Sentimental arguments accepted.
FREE: Half a jar of instant coffee. It is the emergency jar. Treat it with respect.
WANTED: Someone to confirm I did in fact send that email.
LOST: One glove. Right hand. Its partner is inconsolable.
FOR SALE: Wall calendar, still on February. Historically accurate.
NOTICE: Whoever keeps making the good coffee, please identify yourself.
FOUND: A very small screwdriver. Something out there is now loose.
SEEKING: The colleague who knows where the spare batteries are kept.
FREE: Assorted takeaway napkins. Glovebox quality.
WANTED: Advice on how to leave a conversation by the lift.
LOST: The will to reply-all. Please do not return it.
FOR SALE: Bluetooth speaker. Pairs with everything except what you want.
NOTICE: The parcel at reception has been there eleven days. It is humming.
FOUND: An excellent pen in the car park. I am keeping it.
SEEKING: Anyone who remembers the wifi password from before the change.
FREE: Novelty mug with a joke nobody has ever explained.
WANTED: One person willing to take the first biscuit.
LOST: My place in the queue, and with it my dignity.
FOR SALE: Filing cabinet. Contains files. Files not included.
NOTICE: The door is pull. It has always been pull. It says push.
FOUND: A hair tie on the printer. It has been there since the spring.
SEEKING: Someone to tell me the presentation went fine.
FREE: A spider plant with far more children than it can support.
WANTED: The name of whoever fixed the projector. We wish to thank them.
LOST: Contact lens, kitchen area. Please tread thoughtfully.
FOR SALE: Desk drawer organiser. Somehow made it worse.
NOTICE: The 'reserved' sign on that chair has no authority.
FOUND: An entire second set of keys to something.
SEEKING: Confirmation that everyone else also forgot about the training module.
FREE: Leftover sandwiches, meeting room 3. Move quickly and without pride.
WANTED: Someone to hold the other end of this.
LOST: One afternoon. Believed spent on formatting.
FOR SALE: Headphones. One side works. The good side.
NOTICE: We are not doing Secret Santa this year. We are doing it. But quietly.
FOUND: A laminated card that says CALM DOWN. It was working for someone.
SEEKING: The person who brings in the good biscuits. Please continue.
FREE: Office chair, spins excessively. Fun, but not sustainable.
WANTED: Clarification on whether the deadline is Friday or Friday.
LOST: A perfectly good idea, somewhere between the corridor and the desk.
FOR SALE: Laptop stand. Elevated nothing.
NOTICE: The kettle boils faster if you do not watch it. This is not true. Watch it.
FOUND: A jumper on the back of a chair since October. It is now the chair's.
SEEKING: A volunteer for the thing nobody has mentioned yet.
FREE: Four coasters, none of which match the table.
WANTED: Someone to explain the difference between the two shared drives.
LOST: My badge, again. Reception has stopped pretending to be surprised.
FOR SALE: Cable, unknown purpose, excellent condition.
NOTICE: If the printer says PC LOAD LETTER, we have all seen it and we are all afraid.
FOUND: Someone's lunch, clearly labelled, deeply respected.
SEEKING: The origin of the smell near the stairs. Leads welcome.
FREE: A pot plant that has outgrown its pot and its purpose.
WANTED: Someone else to be the first to leave.
LOST: The good stapler. Suspects have been identified.
FOR SALE: Desk lamp. Illuminates one very specific spot.
NOTICE: The meeting has moved. Nobody will tell you where.
FOUND: A biscuit tin containing, as feared, sewing supplies.
SEEKING: Anyone who understands the new expense system. Anyone at all.
FREE: Assorted cables from a device we no longer own.
WANTED: A witness to confirm the kitchen was already like that.
LOST: One water bottle, blue, exactly like everyone else's water bottle.
FOR SALE: Noticeboard. Comes with old notices. Historically significant.
NOTICE: Please stop putting metal in the microwave. This is the third notice.
FOUND: A meeting invite from six weeks ago that nobody declined.
SEEKING: The person who watered my plant while I was away. You are a hero.
FREE: A tin of sweets from a colleague's holiday. Flavours unknowable.
WANTED: Someone to agree that this is, in fact, fine.
LOST: The chair with the good lumbar support. It was here on Friday.
NOTICE: The vending machine took the money and we all watched it happen.
FOUND: An umbrella that is better than mine. I have made a decision.
FOR SALE: Mouse mat with a photograph of somebody's dog. Dog unknown to me.

quotes.author: Novelist, Slightly Altered

forecasts: Fluorescent, with a chance of meetings. Winds calm. Morale variable.
Overcast in the open-plan area, clearing near the window seats by noon.
Warm front moving through the break room. Cold front in the fridge.
Scattered enthusiasm early, giving way to widespread 3pm haze.
Mild throughout, with isolated pockets of unexplained beeping.
High pressure system centred on the printer. Avoid if possible.
Clear and productive until approximately 11:40am. Conditions deteriorate thereafter.
Humid near the kettle. Bring a second shirt if presenting.
Bright and still, with a light drizzle of notifications after lunch.
Unseasonably cheerful. Enjoy it. It will not last past Wednesday.
Persistent low cloud over the inbox. Visibility poor until Thursday.
Gusty conditions near the revolving door. Hold your papers.
Sunny intervals between meetings, though the intervals are brief.
Cold and unforgiving in the north corridor. Pack a cardigan.
Turbulent around the coffee machine between 9 and 10. Approach with patience.
Settled and quiet. Suspiciously so. Something is coming.
Light frost on the shared calendar. Nothing is thawing until Monday.
A band of low motivation moving in from the west, clearing by Friday.
Warm, close, and faintly smelling of somebody's soup.
Fair conditions overall, with localised drama near the stationery cupboard.
Heavy showers of email expected mid-morning. Take shelter where you can.
Dry and still. The plants are not enjoying it and neither are we.
A cold snap around the 2pm review. Dress accordingly.
Hazy with occasional clarity. The clarity is not to be relied upon.
Blustery near the fire exit. Someone has propped it open again.
Steady and unremarkable, which is the best forecast we have issued all month.
Patchy fog over the project timeline. Expect delays.
Rising temperatures in meeting room 2. Ventilation has been requested.
Calm until the deadline reminder, then increasingly stormy.
Mostly clear, with a small but persistent cloud over the expense system.
Chilly start, warming considerably once the good coffee arrives.
Isolated thunder from the direction of the finance department.
Overcast and reflective. Good conditions for putting things off.
Unstable air near the whiteboard. Ideas may condense without warning.
A gentle breeze of goodwill, expected to die out shortly after lunch.
Grey, but a productive sort of grey. Lean into it.
Sharp frost on morale following the reorganisation announcement.
Warm and drowsy after 2pm. Operating heavy spreadsheets is discouraged.
Sudden downpour of urgent requests possible. Keep the afternoon loose.
Bright, breezy, and entirely undeserved. Take the win.
Localised flooding in the kitchen. Somebody has overfilled something again.
Clear skies over the car park. Storm system parked over the inbox.
Static in the air near the photocopier. Do not touch the handle first.
Balmy near the radiator, arctic three desks away. As always.
Drifting fog of half-remembered action items. Visibility improves by Wednesday.
A ridge of high pressure over the quarterly report. It will pass.
Freshening winds from the direction of new hires. Generally welcome.
Muggy and slow. The building is doing its best.
Bright spells interrupted by unscheduled catch-ups.
Cool and crisp. Ideal conditions for actually finishing something.
Low visibility around the org chart. Navigate by feel.
Squally near the shared printer. Two jobs are fighting.
Settled, warm, and dangerously comfortable. Set an alarm.
Heavy cloud with occasional breakthroughs. The breakthroughs are the point.
Rain expected outside. Inside, the usual fluorescent noon.
A cold front arriving with the budget review. Layers advised.
Still air and long shadows. The building sounds different today.
Gentle warmth throughout. Nobody has complained about the temperature. Historic.
Blustery all day, with debris from last week's decisions still blowing about.
Fine and mild, with a chance of someone bringing in cake.
